title: Native approval delivery and reconciliation
goal: Connect durable delivery to the reviewed native card path
acceptance: Restart, duplicate decisions and Telegram/dashboard races reconcile without duplicate effects
Approval creation and one generic durable inbox notice commit atomically; existing pending approvals backfill once without changing old inbox cursors
Native catch-up skips settled/expired approvals and checkpoints them; Telegram retains one card path without duplicate notice sends
No private arguments in OS notification bodies; read-only native credentials never decide or mint browser sessions
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
validation: Run affected regressions across the changed boundary and applicable fast checks
Keep human/device acceptance and independent review distinct from fixture results
Prerequisite T02 accepted after PR229 full CI; durable delivery remains unimplemented, with explicit live-native acceptance limits.
Four new Store/inbox contracts were committed failing before implementation (1a878ac); final CI and live acceptance retain separate evidence
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback
